name: Liquid Media
title: Liquid Media
description: Interactive WebGL fluid ripple distortion effect for images and videos with responsive cursor displacement.
summary: An interactive WebGL media component that responds to cursor movement with fluid ripples and displacement. Features offscreen FBO sprite splats, damping, object-fit texture mapping, and automatic WebGL provider scoping.
highlights: High-performance Three.js shader pipeline with offscreen FBO displacement render target
Sub-pixel cursor velocity tracking with dual-mode idle and active damping physics
Automatic CSS object-fit calculation preserving aspect-ratio cover and contain cropping
Teleported 3D plane synchronization maintaining pixel-perfect DOM alignment on scroll and resize
Supports images and videos (videos default to autoplay, muted, loop and playsInline)
anatomy: <div> (WebglProvider wrapper, position: relative, hosts the canvas when no provider exists)
/
<Canvas> (React Three Fiber Canvas: manages WebGL viewport, frame synchronization, and render loop)
<shaderMaterial> (Custom GLSL Displacement Shader: computes trigonometric UV deflection from FBO)

physics.engine: Three.js GLSL Fragment Shader & Offscreen FBO
physics.description: Up to 100 brush sprites are rendered additively into an offscreen half-float buffer. The shader offsets UVs in a direction derived from the buffer value, scaled by damped cursor speed.

accessibility.aria: Renders a native with alt text, or a native

keyboard.description: Not interactive. The effect is pointer-only.

accessibility.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion, the ripple effect is disabled and the media renders undistorted. Set webglEnabled={false} to turn the effect off explicitly.

props.name: rippleMap
props.description: Custom three.js brush texture for the ripples. Defaults to the built-in brush.

props.name: src
props.description: Source path or URL of the image or video texture to displace.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alternative text for the image. Required when type is "image".

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Classes for the WebGL provider wrapper created when LiquidMedia is used without a WebglProvider.

props.name: type
props.description: Media type discriminator for choosing image or video texture pipeline.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Strength of the liquid displacement distortion waves.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the ripple splats relative to viewport dimensions.

props.name: expandRate
props.description: Rate at which ripple rings expand outward over time.

props.name: decayRate
props.description: Exponential fade decay rate of active ripples.

props.name: segments
props.description: Plane mesh subdivisions used for the media quad.

props.name: webglEnabled
props.description: Toggle to enable WebGL shader displacement or fallback to native DOM media.
